items.title: Monthly call with our lead investor (Balderton Capital)
items.body: Attendees: Thomas, Raoul, our lead partner at Balderton. Summary: happy with the September update and with the healthcare pipeline. Action item: 'Please include net revenue retention (NRR) in the next update. For an infrastructure business it is the number we will be asked about at Series A.'

facts.text: Lead investor (Balderton) asked for NRR in the next update

items.title: Procurement call with Noorderlicht Zorggroep
items.body: Attendees: Thomas, Head of Procurement and the DPO at Noorderlicht. Summary: pilot terms agreed for 9 clinics, kick-off Oct 15. The DPO confirmed that zero audio retention and EU-only processing were what cleared their review.

facts.text: Procurement call with Noorderlicht Zorggroep: pilot terms agreed for 9 clinics, kick-off Oct 15

items.title: Interview: Senior Speech Scientist (candidate 2)
items.body: Attendees: Jarno, Thomas, candidate. Summary: strong background in low-resource languages, second round next week. Pipeline for the role is thin, we need more referrals.

facts.text: Interviewing for a senior speech scientist; candidate pipeline is thin

items.title: Pilot review with Noorderlicht Zorggroep
items.body: Attendees: Thomas, clinical lead, Head of Procurement. Summary: clinicians report dictation is noticeably faster than the previous vendor on Dutch medical vocabulary. The clinical lead said they want to roll out to all 14 clinics in Q1. Nothing signed, no written confirmation yet, procurement will revisit in December.

facts.text: Noorderlicht Zorggroep said they want to roll out to all 14 clinics in Q1
